definitions.explanation: Sweets and desserts that originated in Western countries, as opposed to traditional Japanese sweets. Includes cakes, cookies, chocolate, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋菓子|ようがし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This shop is famous for Western sweets.

examples.japanese: {洋菓子|ようがし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Have Western sweets together with tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{洋菓子|ようがし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詰|つ}め{合|あ}わせ→詰め合わせ：14175_tsumeawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらいました→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received an assortment of Western sweets as a birthday present.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洋菓子|ようがし}⟦{店|てん}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a birthday cake for my friend at the Western sweets shop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洋菓子|ようがし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ばれます→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: Japanese Western sweets are beautiful and delicious, so they are appreciated as gifts.

notes:
⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ (Western) + ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ (confectionery): cakes, cookies, chocolates, cream puffs, tarts and puddings. In daily speech people usually name the item (⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧, ⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧) or say ⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧; {洋菓子|ようがし} is the category word used by shops, makers and gift catalogs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋菓子|ようがし}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: Western-style pastry shop
- {洋菓子|ようがし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詰|つ}め{合|あ}わせ→詰め合わせ：14175_tsumeawase⟧: an assortment of Western sweets (a common gift)
- {洋菓子|ようがし}⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧: pastry chef

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧: Japanese sweets — made mainly with sweet bean paste (⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧), rice flour and sugar, with little or no dairy, and served with green tea
- ⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧: sweets — a trendy catch-all for desserts, Western or Japanese
